name: Brookfield Asset Management

source.publisher: Brookfield Asset Management Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. (NYSE: BAM, TSX: BAM) is a leading global alternative asset manager, headquartered in New York, with over $1 trillion of assets under management across infrastructure, energy, private equity, real estate, and credit.

description: Global alternative asset manager investing in infrastructure, power and real estate, including chip fabs and fuel-cell power.
explain: Brookfield supplies long-term capital to AI's physical layer: it co-funds Intel's Arizona chip factories and set up a financing framework of up to $5 billion for Bloom Energy fuel cells that power data centers.
